scope: Failure-path click-through of the teleop wizard against the locally running car-code agent, with no leader arm and no actuators. This advances 八.8's 错误/取消/状态恢复 half; it is not the real-hardware click acceptance.

how_the_clicks_were_made.method: the in-app browser viewport was not attached (`NATIVE_BROWSER_VIEWPORT_UNAVAILABLE`, visible=false), so pointer clicks could not land. Each action was dispatched through the page's own React onClick handlers (element.click()) and the resulting DOM text was diffed; every action also hit the real HTTP routes, so backend -> store -> re-render is real.
how_the_clicks_were_made.what_this_proves: handler wiring, request payloads, backend verdicts and the text the operator ends up seeing.
how_the_clicks_were_made.what_this_does_not_prove: hit-testing, disabled-look styling, keyboard/mouse focus behaviour, and playback of the episode clip in a real player - a human pointer pass is still required (八.8 stays 未验证 on hardware).

defect_found_by_the_click_through.what: Loading a shipped template and saving it unchanged passed the calibration gate. CalibrationStore.readiness() only checked existence, hash, cross-layer bound identities and joint order, and nothing in app_ros_mobile/lelab referenced the example_not_measured / derived_not_measured markers the templates themselves are written with. Three template layers saved from the page produced ready with a calibration_version, leaving only the missing serial between the operator and 接合跟随.
defect_found_by_the_click_through.why_it_matters: 需求四 forbids silently using default values when enabling, and the placeholder entries are exactly the values that decide direction, zero offsets and soft limits. On the real car this is the difference between 'the operator measured the arm' and 'the arm ran on the shipped guesses'.
defect_found_by_the_click_through.fix: CalibrationStore.unmeasured_paths() walks the stored document and returns the JSON path of every dict flagged _example_not_measured and every string value that starts with example_not_measured / derived_not_measured. readiness() turns each hit layer into a named blocker listing the first four paths plus a remainder count, so 就绪 stays 否 until the operator replaces them. Prose that merely mentions the convention is not a marker: only a leading marker or the explicit flag counts.
defect_found_by_the_click_through.regression: app_ros_mobile/tests/test_mobile_teleop_example_guard.py (4 tests) - the shipped leader/follower/mapping examples each get blocked; the identical documents pass once the flags are dropped and the notes rewritten, so the guard is about the marker and not the template shape; the path scan names joints[1] and gripper.span_note exactly.
